title: The busy-file check compares a batch's lanes with lanes in other open batches built from the same main
why: Lane busy-file-stacked-batches 15:08 CST Nov 12 (#2972): the check compares lanes within one batch request only; express batches now run beside ordinary ones (R55), so two batches built from main can both touch a file unseen.
